text:
elaine: Drafting the PRD for quota + billing edge cases. Wanted to surface a few tricky customer asks before we freeze acceptance criteria. TL;DR: need clarity on pricing semantics for partial tokens, metering windows, and UI presentation for per-route limits.

sam: thanks — can you list the specific customer asks you want prioritized?

elaine: sure. 1) Customer A wants per-minute burst credits that don't count toward monthly quota. 2) Customer B needs metering that charges on 'consumed tokens' vs 'generated tokens' depending on model role. 3) Sales asks a clear UI to show "projected spend" when changing quotas.

kyle: re burst credits — runtime support exists for transient allowances, but they currently decrement the committed capacity metric. Is the ask that bursts be free (no billing) or billed separately at a lower rate?

elaine: they want bursts not billed against monthly quota but billed as overage at a different rate. Example: monthly quota 1M tokens, burst pool 50k tokens that, when used, are billed at overage rate 0.5x standard.

judy: from billing side, overage at a different rate is straightforward but we need deterministic metering semantics. Are we billing per token or per-request rounded up? Edge cases: streaming responses that flush partial tokens mid-request.

maria: we should include explicit rounding rules in the PRD. Proposal: meter at token granularity, apply per-request rounding: ceil(tokens / 10) * 10 for pricing tiering, unless `exact_token_billing=true` for enterprise.

elaine: good. add ACs to PRD: AC1: Billing uses token-granularity by default. AC2: Burst pool tokens are deducted from a separate allowance and billed at defined overage rate if exceeded. AC3: UI shows projected spend for a quota change over 30/90/365 day windows. AC4: API exposes `billing_preview` endpoint returning breakdown.

kyle: implementation notes: runtime needs to tag requests with `billing_bucket` so routing + cache don't misattribute. We'll need a migration plan for existing cached prefixes. Also need SLOs for `billing_preview` < 200ms for interactive UI.

judy: add edge-case: model fallback. If a request downgrades to a quantized model due to capacity, pricing semantics must follow a defined mapping (e.g., quantized variant billed at 0.8x). Can we list that in the PRD as a table?

elaine: yes. I'll add a mapping table. Another edge-case: retries — should retries be deduplicated for billing? Proposal: idempotency key prevents double-billing within 2 minutes.

sam: agree on idempotency window. Also product asks we clarify admin UX for adjusting per-route limits and showing historical enforcement events (rate-limited requests) inline.

maria: small note on metering windows: sliding windows complicate dashboards. We should prefer fixed windows (minute/hour/day) for metering, and offer a "sliding window" toggle for advanced customers. Put that in scope as a stretch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/billing-preview -> staging (sha: ab12cd). Estimated deploy: 10m. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks. Action items: 1) I'll update the PRD with ACs + mapping table + idempotency wording. 2) @kyle to provide runtime tagging spec and migration notes. 3) @judy to confirm billing rounding rules and overage rate math. 4) @sam to mock the UI wire where projected spend toggles between 30/90/365.

kyle: noted, I'll drop a short RFC in #eng-runtime with a proposed schema for `billing_bucket` and `billing_preview` API.

judy: will validate rounding and produce a sample invoice example.

sam: timeline check — can we aim to freeze PRD by EOD Friday?

elaine: yes, aiming for Friday EOD. If you have short comments drop them here or edit the doc: https://redwood.docs/prd/quota-billing-edgecases (will update shortly).

maria: one more tiny edge-case: free-tier usage and trial extensions — ensure UI warns when projected spend > free credits and offers link to upgrade.

elaine: good catch. will add.

sam: sounds solid. :rocket:

elaine: thanks all — I'll ping when PRD is updated.
